en: Here is the step-by-step enrollment process for **Undergraduate Programs, Law & Graduate Programs, and College of Medicine**. Please note that all the data we provided are **General**. If you are finding a specific process, you should directly ask any of the faculty staff in your department.
Step 1. You may look on the picture provided below for the requirements needed.

Step 2: Login to https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph 
• Click on **Admission**
• Click **Show Exam Result** then proceed to enrollment
• Click **Apply Enrollment** 
- **Campus Selection**: Select **Main Campus** 
- **Course Selection**: Select your **Preferred Course** 
- **Documentary Requirements**: Scan and upload the documentary requirements as specified in Step 1 
*(NOTE: All documents uploaded as part of the admission process must be duly marked with a "RECEIVED" stamp by the University Registrar's Office)* 
- **Learning Modality Preference**: Select your **Preferred Learning Modality** 
- **Academic Information**: Fill in the necessary information
Step 3: Approval of Enrollment Application
Wait for the evaluator's approval of your application. Once your application is approved, download your Certificate of Registration (COR) through https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph
*(Click 'Report Incorrect COR' if you find any errors)*
Step 4: Validation of Enrollment, you may look on the image provided below.

en:
Welcome! Don't worry — let me walk you through the full enrollment journey step by step. Here's what you need to do as an **incoming freshman or transferee** at BukSU:

**Step 1: Pass the BukSU College Admission Test (BukSU-CAT)**
Before you can enroll, you must first take and pass the BukSU entrance examination. You can apply for the CAT at https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph.

**Step 2: Check your Exam Result**
Once the results are released, log in to the same portal to check your score and admission status.

**Step 3: Apply for Enrollment Online**
If you passed, proceed to your online enrollment application:
• Go to https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph
• Click **Admission → Show Exam Result**, then click **Apply Enrollment**
• Select your **Campus**, **Preferred Course**, and upload your **Documentary Requirements**

**Step 4: Wait for Approval**
Wait for the evaluator's approval. Once approved, download your **Certificate of Registration (COR)**.

**Step 5: Validate your COR**
Go to **Window 7** at the Finance Building to get your COR validated.

**Step 6: Pay your Tuition**
Proceed to the **Cashier's Office (Window 3)** at the Finance Building to settle your fees.

You can also ask me about any specific step above — I'm here to help!
ceb:
Maayong pag-abot! Ayaw kabalaka — ipasubay ko ikaw sa tibuok proseso sa enrollment. Mao kini ang kinahanglan nimong buhaton bilang **incoming freshman o transferee** sa BukSU:

**Step 1: Pasar sa BukSU College Admission Test (BukSU-CAT)**
Sa wala pa ka maka-enroll, kinahanglan una nimong kuhaon ug mapasaran ang entrance exam sa BukSU. Makapy-apil ka pinaagi sa https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph.

**Step 2: Tan-awon ang Imong Resulta sa Exam**
Kung na-release na ang resulta, log in sa mao gihapon nga portal aron makita ang imong score ug admission status.

**Step 3: Mag-apply og Enrollment Online**
Kung nakapasar ka, padayon sa imong online enrollment application:
• Adto sa https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph
• I-click ang **Admission → Show Exam Result**, dayon i-click ang **Apply Enrollment**
• Pilia ang imong **Campus**, **Preferred Course**, ug i-upload ang imong **Documentary Requirements**

**Step 4: Hulaton ang Approval**
Hulaton ang approval sa evaluator. Kung ma-approve na, i-download ang imong **Certificate of Registration (COR)**.

**Step 5: I-validate ang Imong COR**
Adto sa **Window 7** sa Finance Building aron ma-validate ang imong COR.

**Step 6: Bayad sa Tuition**
Moadto sa **Cashier's Office (Window 3)** sa Finance Building aron bayaran ang imong fees.

Mahimo ka usab mangutana bahin sa bisan unsang specific nga lakang sa ibabaw — naa ko dinhi para matabangan ka!

en: For Face-to-Face or mixed enrollment, the initial process is similar to online enrollment—fill up the requirements on the BukSU Admissions portal.

After completing your online application, proceed to your department to process your pending enrollment. Dedicated faculty staff handle department enrollment. Follow any queue system or line numbers provided.
For 2nd year students and above, you will process directly with your department evaluators.

For Incoming Freshmen and Transferees:
1. Attend the Pre-enrolment Orientation.
2. Proceed to your college of choice for personal interview and present documents in a long brown envelope for evaluation.
3. Proceed to the I.T. Laboratory for Information System Registration and document submission.
ceb: Para sa Face-to-Face o mixed enrollment, parehas ra ang proseso sa online enrollment—pun-a ang mga requirements sa BukSU Admissions portal.
Human sa imong online application, adto sa inyong department aron iproseso ang pending enrollment. Adunay mga faculty staff nga nagdumala sa enrollment sa inyong departamento.
Para sa 2nd year pataas, direkta kamo magproseso sa inyong department evaluators.

Para sa Incoming Freshmen ug Transferees:
1. Motambong sa Pre-enrolment Orientation.
2. Moadto sa napiling kolehiyo para sa interview ug ipresentar ang mga dokumento sa long brown envelope.
3. Moadto sa I.T. Laboratory para sa Information System Registration ug pagpasa sa dokumento.

en:
Make sure you pass the entrance examination, and prepare these requirements. It should be 2 envelopes: Envelope 1 is the Registrar's Copy, and Envelope 2 is the Student's Copy.

1. Program Acceptance Slip
2. Report Card
3. Good Moral
4. Honorable Dismissal (for Transferees only)
5. Transcript of Records (for Transferees only)
6. Subject Equivalency Form (for Transferees only)
7. Photocopy of PSA Birth Certificate
8. Photocopy of Marriage Contract (if Married)
9. BukSU-CAT Report of Rating
10. Photocopy of Medical Certificate

Requirements to be submitted to the department/program:

1. Medical Certificate (The Medical Certificate must be issued by a government Physician and must state that the student is physically fit for "OFF-CAMPUS AND IN-CAMPUS ACTIVITY"). (Original Copy)
2. NOTARIZED GENERAL PARENTAL/GUARDIAN CONSENT FORM (Original Copy)

Download the form here: https://buksu.edu.ph/downloadable-forms/

⚠️ **PROGRAM-SPECIFIC ADVISORY (e.g., BSIT, Nursing, BSBA, Education, etc.):**
While the documents above are the general institutional enrollment requirements for BukSU, specific programs (such as BSIT, Nursing, Accountancy, Education, etc.) may have additional department-level qualifying cutoffs, interview schedules, skill assessments, or program-specific medical guidelines.

📌 For program-specific announcements, qualifying updates, and interview dates for your chosen course, please visit your official College / Department Facebook Page or check https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph/courses
ceb:
Siguroha nga nakapasar ka sa entrance examination, ug i-andam kining mga requirements. Kinahanglan kini og 2 ka envelopes: Envelope 1 para sa Registrar's Copy, ug Envelope 2 para sa Student's Copy.

1. Program Acceptance Slip
2. Report Card
3. Good Moral
4. Honorable Dismissal (para sa Transferees lamang)
5. Transcript of Records (para sa Transferees lamang)
6. Subject Equivalency Form (para sa Transferees lamang)
7. Photocopy sa PSA Birth Certificate
8. Photocopy sa Marriage Contract (kung Minyo)
9. BukSU-CAT Report of Rating
10. Photocopy sa Medical Certificate

Requirements nga kinahanglan i-submit sa department/program:

1. Medical Certificate (Ang Medical Certificate kinahanglan issued gikan sa government Physician ug nagpamatuod nga physically fit for "OFF-CAMPUS AND IN-CAMPUS ACTIVITY"). (Original Copy)
2. NOTARIZED GENERAL PARENTAL/GUARDIAN CONSENT FORM (Original Copy)

I-download ang form diri: https://buksu.edu.ph/downloadable-forms/

⚠️ **PAHINUMDOM PARA SA MGA ESPESIPIKONG KURSO (e.g., BSIT, Nursing, BSBA, Education, ubp.):**
Bisan kini ang mga kinatibuk-ang documentary requirements sa unibersidad, ang mga espesipikong kurso mahimong adunay dugang nga department qualifying exams, interview schedules, cut-off rating, o medical guidelines.

en: Step 4 is Validation of Enrollment from July 1 to August 31, 2026.

For on-site payment: print your Certificate of Registration (COR), then proceed to the Accounting Office, Windows 3 to 5, for account verification. This applies to both paying and non-paying students.
For paying students, pay at the Cashier's Office Window 10.
After account verification or payment, proceed to the University Registrar's Office for enrollment validation. This applies to both paying and non-paying students.
For online payment: access your COR through https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph to determine the required down payment for official enrollment.
Go to https://www.lbp-eservices.com/egps/portal/index.jsp, click Pay Now, search and select Merchant Name: Bukidnon State University, then click Continue.

Select the transaction type Tuition and Other School Fees, then click Continue. Fill out the transaction details, choose your preferred payment mode, input the captcha, agree to the Terms and Conditions, and submit the payment details including OTP and ATM PIN if required.
You can view your enrollment status through SIAS Online 10 working days after payment.
ceb: Ang Step 4 mao ang Validation of Enrollment gikan July 1 hangtod August 31, 2026.

Para sa on-site payment: i-print ang imong Certificate of Registration (COR), dayon adto sa Accounting Office, Windows 3 to 5, para sa account verification. Applicable kini sa paying ug non-paying students.
Para sa paying students, pagbayad sa Cashier's Office Window 10.
Human sa account verification o payment, adto sa University Registrar's Office para sa enrollment validation. Applicable kini sa paying ug non-paying students.
Para sa online payment: access imong COR sa https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph aron makita ang required down payment para sa official enrollment.
Adto sa https://www.lbp-eservices.com/egps/portal/index.jsp, i-click ang Pay Now, pangitaa ug pili-a ang Merchant Name: Bukidnon State University, dayon click Continue.

Pili-a ang transaction type nga Tuition and Other School Fees, dayon click Continue. Pun-a ang transaction details, pili-a ang preferred payment mode, input captcha, agree sa Terms and Conditions, ug i-submit ang payment details apil ang OTP ug ATM PIN kung required.
Makita nimo ang enrollment status sa SIAS Online 10 working days after payment.

en: How do incoming first-year students claim their SIAS account and default password?

For incoming first-year students, your SIAS (Student Information Accounting System) account is automatically generated after your on-site enrollment is validated and your Certificate of Registration (COR) is approved by the Registrar.
Your **Student ID Number** (found at the top of your COR) serves as your SIAS Username.

To log in: 1. Access https://sias.buksu.edu.ph/sias/. 2. If you don't know your default password, click **'Find SIAS Account'** or **'Forgot Password'** and enter your registered email address. 3. If you still cannot access it, visit the ICT Service Unit (ICTU) or the Registrar's Office for account activation.
ceb: Paano po mag-claim ng SIAS account and default password para sa incoming first year?

Para sa mga incoming first-year students, ang imong SIAS (Student Information Accounting System) account awtomatikong ma-generate human ma-validate ang imong enrollment ug ma-aprobahan ang imong Certificate of Registration (COR) sa Registrar.
Ang imong **Student ID Number** (makita sa ibabaw sa imong COR) mao ang imong SIAS Username.

Aron maka-login: 1. Ablihi ang https://sias.buksu.edu.ph/sias/. 2. Kung wala nimo nahibal-an ang default password, i-click ang **'Find SIAS Account'** o **'Forgot Password'** ug isulod ang imong registered email. 3. Kung dili gihapon ka maka-access, adtoa ang ICT Service Unit (ICTU) o ang Registrar's Office aron ma-activate ang account.

en: What happens if I submit my enrollment documents late?
Late submission of required enrollment documents may cause delays in validating your Certificate of Registration (COR) and finalizing your official subject enlistment in the SIAS system.
If your documents are not submitted within the prescribed enrollment extension period, your temporary reservation/slot may be placed on hold or forfeited in favor of waitlisted applicants.

If you are experiencing document delays (e.g. late release of Form 138 from your high school or PSA certificate), coordinate immediately with the Office of the University Registrar and file a promissory request before the deadline.
ceb: Unsay mahitabo kung ma-late ko pag-submit sa akong enrollment documents?
Ang ulahing pag-submit sa required enrollment documents makapadelay sa pag-validate sa imong Certificate of Registration (COR) ug sa opisyal nga subject enlistment sa SIAS portal.
Kung dili nimo ma-submit ang mga dokumento sulod sa gitakdang extension period sa enrollment, ang imong temporaryong slot mahimong ma-hold o ma-forfeit para sa mga waitlisted nga aplikante.
Kung na-delay ang imong dokumento (sama sa Form 138 o PSA), pakig-alayon dayon sa Office of the University Registrar ug paghimo og promissory request sa dili pa ang deadline.
